sources.content: AGENTS.md for Calderix. Calderix is a build orchestrator for CI pipelines, written in Go. Build the binary with make build; the output lands in bin/calderix. Run unit tests with make test and the slower integration tests with make itest, which needs Docker running. The minimum Go version is 1.22. Pipeline definitions are parsed in internal/pipeline, and every parser change needs a new fixture under testdata/pipelines. Do not edit files in gen/; they are regenerated by make generate.

Conventions: use the standard library log/slog package for logging, never fmt.Println. Error messages start with a lowercase letter and carry no trailing period. Every pull request needs one entry in changes/ named after the pull request number. Run make lint before pushing; it runs golangci-lint with the config in .golangci.yml. Releases are cut from tags that match v*, and only maintainers may push tags. Keep the default job timeout at 45 minutes unless an issue approves a change.
